name: Ooki
rootCause: In November 2021, a developer of Ooki (formerly bZx) was phished, leading to private-key compromise of Polygon and BNB Chain deployer accounts. About $55 million was stolen from protocol and user wallets using the compromised keys. A bZx developer opened a phishing email attachment containing a malicious Word macro, leading to the exfiltration of his wallet mnemonic and the private keys used by the project to deploy on Polygon and BNB Chain. The attacker gained full control of these deployer accounts, enabling them to drain protocol and user funds.
